description: Step 3 picking model: IDH-mutant astrocytomas, grade 4 against grade 3 (TCGA histological grade, IDH and 1p/19q from cBioPortal). Every grade 4 patient with all their slides; 50 grade 3 patients, one slide each. FFPE and CPTAC (fixative not recorded). Slides of at least 100 MB. Stage and embed only (SKIP_TRAIN=1): no triage model is trained.
